items.title: How much unrelated code sits in the blast radius of one edit?
items.description: Grounded in L3's MonthlyReportGenerator: three responsibilities (fetch, calculate, render) were bundled into one ~15-line method. Set responsibilities bundled to 1 to see the structurally-zero-risk baseline (nothing unrelated to touch), then push it up to reproduce the incident's shape at 3 — roughly two-thirds of the method was code an editor had to scroll past for any single change. Try adjusting lines per responsibility to see how a larger, more complex class makes the same bundling mistake even riskier.
items.compute: const totalLines = params.responsibilitiesBundled * params.linesPerResponsibility; const unrelatedLines = totalLines - params.linesPerResponsibility; const riskPercent = totalLines > 0 ? Math.round((unrelatedLines / totalLines) * 1000) / 10 : 0; return { riskPercent };

outputs.label: Share of the method that's unrelated to any one edit
